settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.text: Free shipping on orders over $50. 30-day returns on unused items in original packaging.

settings.heading: Materials
settings.text: Precision-milled from aerospace-grade materials. Built to last and designed to match.

settings.title: Aerospace-grade titanium, milled to micron precision.
settings.text: Every Luminor titanium case is forged from Grade 5 aerospace alloy — the same spec used in Apple's iPhone 15 Pro chassis — then CNC-milled and bead-blasted to a soft, fingerprint-resistant finish. It's twice the strength of steel at less than half the weight, so your iPhone stays protected without the bulk.

settings.title: MagSafe, perfectly aligned.
settings.text: N52 Neodymium magnets deliver a locked-in 15W charge every time you snap on. Precision-machined ring matches Apple's MagSafe geometry to the tenth of a millimeter.

settings.title: Titanium, not aluminum.
settings.text: Grade 5 aerospace titanium body — stronger than stainless steel, lighter than aluminum. Anodized in Apple's matching finishes for a seamless ecosystem look.

settings.title: USB-C fast charge.
settings.text: Pass-through 30W USB-C charging keeps your iPhone 15 Pro topped up while the case is on, with built-in thermal management that won't throttle your device.

settings.title: Lifetime Luminor warranty.
settings.text: We build accessories to outlast the device they protect. Every titanium case ships with a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects — register within 30 days to activate.

settings.title: Engineered for the Apple ecosystem.
settings.subtitle: Every detail considered. Every material chosen for a reason.

settings.heading: Designed in California. Built for the Apple ecosystem.
settings.text: We don't make accessories for every phone. We make them for the one in your pocket — engineered to Apple's exacting tolerances, crafted from the same aerospace materials, and obsessively refined until the seam between device and accessory disappears. A Luminor isn't an add-on. It's the finishing detail the product was always meant to have.
